arguments.subject: Acme Q1 Market Data Information
arguments.body:
Hi Priya,

Please find below our Q1 market data information for Acme as part of your client briefing. Let me know if you need further details or have any questions.

---
1. 2026-01-06: Category share (protein bars): 18.4%. Source: Nielsen scanner Q4-Q1 pull. Analyst note: share up 60bps QoQ — driven by club channel reset. Confidence: high.
2. 2026-01-12: Retail velocity (protein bar SKU): 4.7 units/store/week. Source: IRI scan. Analyst note: steady — top-3 SKU in category. Confidence: high.
3. 2026-01-15: Regional momentum (southeast): +12% YoY. Source: Acme syndicated dashboard. Analyst note: strongest region — pull-through from Walmart reset. Confidence: high.
4. 2026-01-23: Promo lift (January): +22% during MLK weekend reset. Source: Acme syndicated dashboard. Analyst note: outperformed planned +15%. Confidence: high.
5. 2026-02-03: Category share (protein bars): 18.6%. Source: Nielsen scanner Feb pull. Analyst note: share holding — Verdant flat — see analyst note. Confidence: high.
6. 2026-02-08: Retail velocity (protein bar SKU): 4.9 units/store/week. Source: IRI scan. Analyst note: uptick — Q1 promo driving trial. Confidence: high.
7. 2026-02-16: Regional momentum (west): +8% YoY. Source: Acme syndicated dashboard. Analyst note: below plan +12% — competitive pressure from private label. Confidence: high.
8. 2026-02-22: Share of voice (digital): 33% of category SOV. Source: Pathmatics digital ad scrape. Analyst note: leading category — Verdant at 24%. Confidence: high.
9. 2026-02-27: Promo lift (February): +18% during Super Bowl window. Source: Acme syndicated dashboard. Analyst note: met plan. Confidence: high.
10. 2026-03-08: Category share (protein bars): 18.9%. Source: Nielsen scanner March pull. Analyst note: share continuing to grow — Verdant flat-to-down. Confidence: high.
11. 2026-03-18: Retail velocity (protein bar SKU): 5.1 units/store/week. Source: IRI scan. Analyst note: best Q1 reading — momentum continues. Confidence: high.
12. 2026-03-25: Regional momentum (northeast): +9% YoY. Source: Acme syndicated dashboard. Analyst note: steady — no notable competitive shifts. Confidence: high.
13. 2026-03-30: Share of voice (digital): 34% of category SOV. Source: Pathmatics digital ad scrape. Analyst note: steady leadership — recommend hold spend in Q2. Confidence: high.
---

Best regards,
Daniel Park
